commit.message:
feat(mcp): render_stock - the simulated stock as a PNG image block

A headless agent can now see what the program leaves. render_stock runs
the column verdict's program sim (simulate_document, the post gate's
own), paints its sheet by deviation class, skirts open edges down to
the stock floor, and rasterises it on the CPU (new app::raster: edge
functions, z-buffer, flat Lambert, fixed iso/top orthographic camera
fitted to the scene) into a PNG. Optional toolpath overlay (feed blue,
plunge amber, rapid red). The answer carries a JSON summary (rest and
gouge cells/volume/max/where, rest top bounds, stock bounds) and an MCP
image content block; tool_ok lifts the reserved _png_base64 key out of
the JSON into that block.

Deterministic: single-threaded, scene-fitted camera; pinned by the new
mcp_render suite (same bytes twice and across sessions, decoded size,
stock pixels, named refusals for no sim and bad arguments).

png 0.18 (already in Cargo.lock via image) is now a direct dependency of
camcraft-app; base64 is a small in-tree RFC 4648 encoder.

Fixes #182

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(mcp): render_stock pinned on a real cut and a through-cut

render_stock_shows_what_the_program_cut faces the block 2 mm off the
top (stock top 18, rest 40 x 40 x 3 = 4800 mm^3, rest top at 18) and then
down to the part top (rest gone, stock top 15): the picture's bytes
change, the amber rest region over the part repaints clean, and the
summary follows each cut.

render_stock_refuses_when_no_material_stands faces below the stock
floor. The column grid is semi-infinite, so that used to draw a sheet
hanging under the block; the render now clips the sheet to the stock's
floor (columns at or below it are air, walls stop there), which makes
the "no surface to render" refusal reachable and pinned.

Refs #182

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
